# Visual Click Prompt (VCP)

> Interactive visual in-context prompting Chrome extension for live websites with multi-page persistent pins and direct bridge to Antigravity AI agents.

## Core Capabilities
- Point and click on any web element to trigger a floating in-context prompt popover right at the clicked coordinate.
- Zero host page styling interference via open Shadow Root (<vcp-feedback-root>) with all: initial resets and CSP-safe inlined CSS.
- Persistent numbered glowing dots remaining at clicked spots, glued to elements across scrolling and window resizing.
- Multi-page persistence: Pins stored in chrome.storage.local partitioned by domain and normalized route, surviving SPA client-side navigations.
- Resilient multi-tier DOM anchoring: test-ids, sanitized CSS selectors, W3C text quotes, structural XPath, and geometric ratios.
- Local bridge daemon on 127.0.0.1:8765 writes structured Markdown briefs to FEEDBACK_PROMPT.md and .gemini/tasks/ in target project workspaces.
- Autonomous agent auto-triggering via Antigravity CLI (agy).
- 1-click Windows protocol launch via vcp://start.

## Project Structure
- extension/: Chrome Extension Manifest V3 source code (content.js, background.js, popup.html, popup.js, popup.css).
- bridge/: Local HTTP bridge server (server.js, package.json, test-bridge.js).
- start-bridge.bat: 1-click Windows launcher.
- register-protocol.bat: Windows URL protocol registration for vcp://start.
- FEEDBACK_PROMPT.md: Primary active task brief in any workspace.
